scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend/admin-ui ci
scripts.install:build-deps: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend/admin-ui ci
scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma generate --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix backend/admin-ui run build && vite build --configLoader native
scripts.build:aws: npm run build:apps && npm run prerender && npm run verify-seo
scripts.build: npm run install:build-deps && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && npm run build:aws
scripts.db:deploy: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma migrate deploy --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:status: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma migrate status --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.start: cd backend && node scripts/resolve-service-packages-migration.js && npx prisma migrate deploy && node scripts/sync-service-packages.js && node scripts/sync-home-hero.js && node server.js
scripts.build:seo: npx vite build --configLoader native && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/verify-seo.mjs
